newsitem.title: USA: ConAgra sets odd-lot shareholder program.
newsitem.headline: ConAgra sets odd-lot shareholder program.

text.p: ConAgra Inc said Wednesday it will launch a programme that will enable holders of fewer than 100 shares to either buy enough stock to reach 100 shares or sell their holdings.

The buy-sell programme is voluntary and expires on April 1, unless the company extends the programme, ConAgra said. Participants will pay a processing fee of $0.75 a share, with a minimum fee of $15 per account, to defray the program's costs, the company said.
ConAgra said it will neither buy nor sell any of the shares.
As of November 24, ConAgra had about 230 million shares outstanding.
ConAgra is a food processing company.
Its shares closed up 5/8 Wednesday at 53-1/2.
